subject: Vendr portal: initial inventory & evidence window
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-health.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal: initial inventory & evidence window

Hi Marta —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. We’re ready to start the Vendr portal onboarding for Acme Health and want to align the first evidence window so your security team sees minimal churn.

Quick ask: can you confirm a 7-day window next week (Mon–Sun) where your team can accept uploads and QC small proof artifacts? Our proposal is:
- Inventory export + CAIQ answers: Wed (day 3)
- SOC 2 sample artifacts: Fri (day 5)
- Final review handoff: following Tue (day 9)

Attached is a one-page onboarding checklist and a draft SOC 2→SIG mapping we’ll use to pre-populate fields in Vendr. If that schedule is tight, we can compress to 4 days but will need designated upload owners on your side.

I’ll be the primary contact from Redwood for inventory and field mapping. Camila (cc’d) will handle the technical proof uploads and S3 presign instructions.

Next steps:
1) Confirm the 7-day window or propose alternate dates
2) Tell us the preferred contact for evidence uploads (name + email)
3) Share any restrictive upload limits (size, file type) we should know now

Thanks — look forward to getting this staged.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Security & Integrations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-vendr-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), soc2-sig-mapping-draft.pdf (PDF)
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-health.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: initial inventory & evidence window

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear plan. The week of Mar 22–28 works for us as the 7-day window. Primary upload owners will be me and our security engineer, Miguel Ruiz (miguel.ruiz@acme-health.com). We have S3 presign available and a 250MB single-file limit on the portal.

A couple of notes from our side:
- We will not be able to surface production logs for SOC 2 samples until the 2nd week due to a change freeze; if you need them earlier we’ll provide sanitized excerpts.
- For CAIQ questions, please pre-fill anything that’s standard (network diagrams, org chart) and we’ll validate.

I’ll ask procurement to stand by for any DocuSign or vendor agreements during the window.

Best,
Marta
Director, Information Security
Acme Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-health.com>, miguel.ruiz@acme-health.com
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: initial inventory & evidence window

Hi Marta / Miguel —

Appreciate the quick confirmation. We’ll target Mar 22–28. Camila and I will:
- Pre-fill the CAIQ with the standard network diagram and org chart (we’ll attach a draft to the Vendr portal on Mon)
- Stage SOC 2 artifacts as redacted logs where necessary and flag any production-only samples for the week after

Question for you: does your security team prefer we upload artifacts under a single consolidated manifest, or create discrete per-item proof entries in Vendr? Some portal integrations make discrete entries easier for reviewers, but manifests are simpler for bulk retention.

Also copying a short checklist of things we’ll need during the window:
- SSO service account or one-time presign tokens (you noted S3 presign)
- Contact for quick clarifications (phone + slack) — it helps speed QC when we hit field mismatches
- Any internal PO/contract ID to include with uploaded artifacts so procurement can match records

If it helps, Camila can host a 20-minute presign walk-through on Tue at 10am PT — will that work?

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 14:45:00 -07:00

Looping me in as requested. I’m happy to coordinate procurement-side items and any invoice/PO metadata that needs to be attached to evidence. Marta — if procurement generates a short vendor form or a DocuSign with purchase metadata, please send to laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com and I’ll reconcile on our end.

Jonas — please confirm the final list of artifacts you’ll push during the first three days so I can pre-authorize any procurement tags.

—Laura
Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference
